claudeMdRules: No direct DB calls from UI — all data flows through Convex queries/mutations
Convex validators required — every query/mutation must declare args and returns validators
Bounded reads — every .collect() must use .take(n) or pagination
Indexes for queries — use .withIndex() for filtered reads
